answers.core: This is giving a whole new purpose for the Frame Coordinates, and would make lots of lives easier. It definitely would help me and others.
answers.workaround: I think it would be used very often, especially for people like me, creating top-down 2D games, as it makes things way easier to animate and code. And my only current solution is creating a new Sprite or adding a lot of unnecessary feeling animations.
